title: pub.tangled.feedItem
description: Private imported feed entry body. Source data is evidence, not a native authored activity. Signed envelope ts records local arrival; source timestamps remain unmodified. Imported entries are immutable in the initial client.

subscription.description: Stable signed record URI, never an HTTP source identity.

sourceId.description: Original Atom id / RSS guid, else original link, else deterministic normalized-content hash. Scoped to sourceUrl for deduplication.

link.description: Original source link, possibly absent, relative, or unsafe. Consumers must validate before opening.

body.description: Untrusted source content; never execute it or insert HTML without sanitization. Exact XML remains in provenance blob.

publishedAt.description: Original source timestamp verbatim; empty when absent. No guaranteed date format.

updatedAt.description: Original Atom updated value verbatim; empty when absent.

blob.description: CID of exact supplied UTF-8 XML bytes. No claim that a network fetch occurred.
